note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay mapping). Luxembourg was a founding EU member state (free trade inside the single market) with a social market economy. Conscription is set to volunteer force: compulsory military service was abolished in 1967 (Wikipedia: Luxembourg Army). Healthcare is social insurance: compulsory health insurance funded by levies on incomes and payrolls (Wikipedia: Healthcare in Luxembourg). Energy is set to fossil first: the country had no nuclear power (a planned plant was cancelled in 1977) and imported almost all of its energy (2004: 54 of 55 TWh of primary energy; Wikipedia: Energy in Luxembourg); this is a gameplay judgement. Religion and state is set to pluralist secularism (gameplay judgement).
